selection: Named source-available first statutory extractive-payment publishers; verify statutory reports and actual publication year before new outcome estimation. No sign-based substitutions. Rio voluntary Taxes paid release is not automatic proof of actual statutory filing.
comparisons: Select 60 largest g-1 US ordinary resource-extraction parents by pre-event cap with period-keyed CIK/CUSIP and bounded ISIN; inspect contemporary SEC headers, primary-US-share listing and scope language. US Section13q had no operative first obligation in 2016-18. Foreign group/subsidiary and voluntary reporting remain possible spillovers, not certified absence.
weights: GDP within fixed source-study country universe; equal-family and pre-event treated-cap across same supported families. Preserve both requested weights coequally.
composition_diagnostics: Decompose cap-minus-equal by family contribution. Report cap concentration, effective family count, and leave-one-family-out sensitivity for every family, without selecting a preferred omission. Do not search weights to obtain significance.
mechanism_story: Separate public mandatory report content from private tax returns, first statutory cycle from first-ever information, and issuer effects from geographic exposure. These distinctions do not imply positive results.
inference: Descriptive issuer sampling intervals, few legal waves; no causal policy significance. Preserve all prior family coefficients and all results regardless of sign.
